llm.summary: APD became dead money and underperformed SPY under a mixed cause assignment, while the process remained clean. Materials regime, sector rotation, and company-specific weakness are unresolved competing mechanisms.
llm.root_cause: APD became dead money and underperformed SPY under a mixed cause assignment, while the process remained clean. Materials regime, sector rotation, and company-specific weakness are unresolved competing mechanisms.
llm.lesson: The buy process was clean, but the Materials, macro-regime, and company-alpha books did not provide enough recorded discrimination.
llm.engines_credit: The execution organ is not implicated; the regime, Materials-rotation, and alpha books require comparative research before any laggard is named conclusively.

causal_chain.mechanism: An unfavorable cyclical or macro environment may have reduced demand for Materials exposure.
causal_chain.counterfactual: A supportive entry-date Materials regime would weaken the macro explanation.

causal_chain.mechanism: APD may have lacked sufficient company-specific strength to overcome the broader environment.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Strong peer-relative performance would contradict company weakness as the primary mechanism.

causal_chain.mechanism: Conditioning the setup on Materials breadth and macro cyclicality may separate productive from dead-money environments.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Test the same setup across entry-date regime cells without tightening the selection gate.

alternate_explanations: APD-specific execution or fundamental concerns may have dominated.
The negative excess return may reflect unusually strong SPY performance rather than a large absolute decline.

signal_hypotheses.feature: Alignment between Materials setups and the contemporaneous cyclical regime
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Compare matured outcomes by entry-date Materials breadth, commodity sensitivity, and macro-cycle indicators.
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Aligned cyclical and sector conditions should be associated with better relative outcomes.
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: Regime alignment has no relationship with subsequent Materials performance.
